title: Old Bonds
next_chapter_hook: As the three bonds intertwined, a strange voice suddenly echoed from the depths of fate—it was Chen Ling, Chen Ji's sister who had been missing for years. Why would her voice appear here?

text.content: Two voices traversed the endless void, and Chen Ji felt as if something had struck his chest. Those were voices so familiar to his bones, yet thought never to be heard again—one cold as frost, the other bewitching as fire, intertwining across the shore of time into the most moving melody.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji... you useless wretch, still not dead?

text.content: That voice... was Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect. Three years ago, she had witnessed Chen Ji being publicly humiliated when his fiancée broke off their engagement. Unlike others, she didn't mock or leave. Instead, she frowned at him, then turned and walked away. Chen Ji remembered that single glance for three whole years.

dialogue.content: Little deceiver, you promised me something, but you haven't fulfilled it yet. Dying here, I will never forgive you.

text.content: Ye Qing's voice carried the Demonic Path's unique enchantment, yet also contained a sincerity only Chen Ji could comprehend. The Holy Sect's saint, a woman who should have been his mortal enemy, chose to stand alongside him because of a future revealed by the Tianji Record. Such is the irony of fate.

In the celestial illusion, Su Qingyao's figure gradually materialized. She maintained her cold demeanor, her brows sharp as swords, but Chen Ji clearly noticed her fingers gripping her sleeves turning slightly pale. Why didn't she mock him like everyone else at the broken engagement banquet three years ago?

dialogue.content: That day when I called you a wretch, it wasn't mockery... I wanted you to leave this vortex. Did you think I couldn't see through that old fox Ling Yuan's scheme? But you idiot, had to walk straight into this dead end!

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened intensely. That single utterance was never meant as an insult, but Su Qingyao's unique way of warning him. She had long seen through Ling Yuan's conspiracy, yet couldn't speak plainly, so she used the label 'waste' to push him away from the vortex's center.

But he didn't leave. Too proud, he'd rather act like a wretch trampled by all, refusing to admit being seen through. So he kept performing, endured, continued playing the humble servant disciple before everyone. Su Qingyao watched for three years, her heart aching for three years.

Just then, a black-purple light pierced the illusion, and Ye Qing's phantom slowly appeared. Surrounded by the Demonic Path's unique cold mist, her enchanting eyes flickered with a light only Chen Ji could understand—trust and reliance.

dialogue.content: I always knew the Tianji Record wasn't your sole gameboard. The Holy Sect, Xuanwu Sect, even that old thing Ling Yuan... they all used you. Laughably, I initially came with the same intention of using you.
But the future you showed me... no ending of being drained dry by the Holy Sect, only a version of myself who could choose my own fate. Little deceiver, do you understand what this means to me?

text.content: Chen Ji understood perfectly. In the Holy Sect, Ye Qing was merely a tool, her bloodline, her talent, everything belonged to the sect. Only he, through the future revealed by the Tianji Record, allowed her to first glimpse herself, not a tool.

Yet at this moment, an ancient voice rang within Chen Ji's soul. The voice was so faint it seemed ready to dissipate at any moment, yet carried a heart-wrenching familiarity—it was Mo Xiansheng, his master who guarded the Tianji Record with his remnant soul.

dialogue.content: Ji'er... Master only hopes you live for yourself.

text.content: These few words froze Chen Ji completely. Mo Xiansheng had never directly interfered with any of his decisions, even in the most dangerous moments providing only hints, never answers. But this time, he heard his master's true hope—not some Heavenly Fate inheritance, not some grand world chess game, just four simple words: live for yourself.

Three bonds converged in Chen Ji's heart. Su Qingyao's protection, Ye Qing's trust, Mo Xiansheng's hope... they all loved him in their own ways. Now, he must choose—three paths, involving not just his own life and death, but the final destiny of these bonds.

The celestial illusion began to tremble, fate's gears turning once more. Chen Ji felt three forces pulling him from different directions—one leading to Su Qingyao's orthodox path, one toward Ye Qing's Demonic Path abyss, and another... the unknown road guided by Mo Xiansheng.

choice.prompt: Three bonds intertwined at fate's crossroads. How should Chen Ji choose?

choices.description: Sever the bonds, bear the Tianji Record's fate alone, keeping them far from controversy.
choices.visible_reward: Fully master the Tianji Record's complete power
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption will be shared by no one

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, whispering softly: 'All of you, go back. This path... was never meant for you to walk.' The moment his words fell, he felt the bonds with Su Qingyao and Ye Qing being forcibly severed by some force.

choices.description: Awaken all bond power, stand shoulder to shoulder with them against Heavenly Fate.
choices.visible_cost: Expose all trump cards to the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the 'Shared Destiny' bond, Heavenly Fate consumption divided
choices.risk_hint: All three enemies will unite in siege

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly opened his eyes, forming seals with both hands. The symbols on the Tianji Record Fragment blazed madly: 'Since none of you will leave... then stay together!' Two streams of bond power flooded into him, fate beginning to reverse.

choices.description: Use himself as offering, utterly destroy the Heavenly Eye's chess game, granting them true freedom.
choices.visible_reward: Completely end the Heavenly Chess game, bonds eternal
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ji's existence will be completely erased

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at the two phantoms, a serene smile forming on his lips: 'Master said to live for myself... but my true self exists precisely to protect you.' The Tianji Record began burning, his figure gradually dissolving into light.

Yet just as the three bonds' power was about to decide, a crisp, familiar voice suddenly echoed from fate's depths. Young yet stubborn, it seemed to traverse endless rivers of time, carrying a tone nearly accusatory—

dialogue.content: Brother... what about my choice? How dare you decide for me?
